source.name: Kaizen Gaming: Betano and Sporting CP renew partnership until 2029
source.quote: will continue to support the Alvalade club as the Main Sponsor. The renewed agreement covers both the First Team and the B Team, which currently competes in the second league, with Betano maintaining prominent branding on the front of both teams’ official shirts

source.name: Footy Headlines: Gold Sporting 26-27 Away Kit Released - Total 90 Inspired
source.quote: On the upper back, the number "120" sits above the Super Bock sponsor to commemorate the club's 120th anniversary.
source.note: This article is about the 2026-27 away shirt. No text source found that names the back sponsor of the 2026-27 home shirt: the press reports of its launch on 13 July 2026 (A Bola, Record, O Jogo, TVI) and Footy Headlines' home-kit article don't name it.

source.name: Footy Headlines: Sporting CP 26-27 Home Kit Released
source.quote: The Nike Sporting CP 26-27 home kit features the club's legendary green and white hoops, without any other colors.
source.note: Kit maker; not a shirt sponsor in the front/back/sleeve sense.

summary: Betano (Kaizen Gaming) on the front and Super Bock on the back; Nike is the kit maker. Not marked complete: no cited source lists every placement on the shirt.
